title: Pay Attention To
subtitle: pay attention to = 留意；注意；專注於；重視
description: pay attention to = 留意；注意；專注於；重視

words.note: 當 pay attention to 強調把主要注意力放在某項工作、問題或目標上時，focus on 很自然。
words.example: Please focus on the instructions before starting the task.

exercises.original: Please pay attention to the instructions before starting the task.
exercises.zh: 開始工作前，請專注閱讀指示。
exercises.upgrade: focus on · 專注於；集中注意力於

options.explanation: 開始任務前要把主要注意力放在 instructions 上，最自然。
只表示看着，不保證有專心閱讀。

exercises.original: During the meeting, pay attention to the three issues that require a decision.
exercises.zh: 會議期間，請專注於三個需要決定的議題。
exercises.upgrade: focus on · 專注於；集中注意力於

options.explanation: 重點是把會議注意力集中在三個核心議題。
只是注意到，不表示把主要注意力放在上面。

exercises.original: The report should pay attention to the causes of the problem rather than minor details.
exercises.zh: 報告應專注於問題的成因，而不是枝節。
exercises.upgrade: focus on · 專注於；集中注意力於

options.explanation: rather than minor details 明確表示應集中於主要內容。
只表示留意，不夠突出主次。

words.note: 當 pay attention to 指不要忽略某項訊息、變化或細節，而要特別留意時，take notice of 很精確。
words.example: Drivers should take notice of changes to the road signs.

exercises.original: Drivers should pay attention to changes to the road signs.
exercises.zh: 駕駛者應留意道路標誌的改動。
exercises.upgrade: take notice of · 留意；注意到

options.explanation: 重點是不要忽略 road-sign changes，而要特別留意。
可以表示專注，但語氣比這裡所需更強。
偏仔細觀看或記錄，不如 take notice of 自然。
通常是持續觀看某物，不適合 changes 這個抽象受詞。

exercises.original: Customers should pay attention to the expiry date before using the product.
exercises.zh: 顧客使用產品前應留意有效日期。
exercises.upgrade: take notice of · 留意；注意到

options.explanation: expiry date 是使用前需要特別留意的資訊。
通常表示處理某事，而不是查看日期。

exercises.original: The committee should pay attention to the concerns raised by local residents.
exercises.zh: 委員會應留意本地居民提出的憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: take notice of · 留意；注意到

options.explanation: 表示這些 concerns 不應被忽略，而應獲得重視。
只表示查看，未必表示重視。

words.note: 比 focus on 更強調持續集中精神，尤其適合學習、閱讀、工作或需要高度注意力的活動。
words.example: Try to concentrate on the question before choosing an answer.

exercises.original: Try to pay attention to the question before choosing an answer.
exercises.zh: 選答案前，嘗試集中精神閱讀問題。
exercises.upgrade: concentrate on · 集中精神於；專心於

options.explanation: 選答案前需要持續集中精神理解問題。

exercises.original: She found it difficult to pay attention to her reading because of the noise outside.
exercises.zh: 因為外面很嘈吵，她很難集中精神閱讀。
exercises.upgrade: concentrate on · 集中精神於；專心於

options.explanation: noise 令人難以維持注意力，concentrate on 最精確。

exercises.original: During the test, students need to pay attention to each question carefully.
exercises.zh: 測驗期間，學生需要集中精神處理每一道問題。
exercises.upgrade: concentrate on · 集中精神於；專心於

options.explanation: test 語境需要持續集中精神處理每題。
表示快速看一眼，和 carefully 不合。

words.note: 當 pay attention to 不只是「看見」，而是需要處理某個問題、需要或細節時，attend to 很自然。
words.example: The technician will attend to the fault this afternoon.

exercises.original: The technician will pay attention to the fault this afternoon and repair it if necessary.
exercises.zh: 技術員今天下午會處理這個故障，必要時進行維修。
exercises.upgrade: attend to · 留意並處理；處理

options.explanation: 這裡不只是留意 fault，而是會實際處理。

exercises.original: Staff must pay attention to customer complaints promptly.
exercises.zh: 員工必須迅速處理顧客投訴。
exercises.upgrade: attend to · 留意並處理；處理

options.explanation: promptly 顯示需要實際處理 complaints，不只是留意。

exercises.original: The manager needs to pay attention to several urgent staffing issues today.
exercises.zh: 經理今天需要處理數項緊急人手問題。
exercises.upgrade: attend to · 留意並處理；處理

options.explanation: urgent issues 需要處理和跟進，attend to 很自然。
只知道問題存在不足夠。
通常接 advice、warning，不自然接 staffing issues。

words.note: 較正式，常表示在做事時要特別記住某個限制、風險、需要或影響。
words.example: Staff should be mindful of customers' privacy when handling records.

exercises.original: Staff should pay attention to customers' privacy when handling records.
exercises.zh: 員工處理紀錄時應特別注意顧客私隱。
exercises.upgrade: be mindful of · 留意；謹記；注意

options.explanation: 表示做事時要一直把 privacy 這項要求放在心上。
偏觀看或遵守某些規則，但不如 be mindful of 自然。

exercises.original: Visitors should pay attention to the uneven ground near the entrance.
exercises.zh: 訪客應注意入口附近不平坦的地面。
exercises.upgrade: be mindful of · 留意；謹記；注意

options.explanation: 這是一項需要一直記住的安全風險。
只表示看，不一定代表小心。
若用於安全警告通常需不同結構，如 watch your step。
缺少 be 和介詞 of。

exercises.original: When planning the event, pay attention to the needs of people with disabilities.
exercises.zh: 策劃活動時，要注意殘疾人士的需要。
exercises.upgrade: be mindful of · 留意；謹記；注意

options.explanation: planning 過程中要把特定人士的需要納入考慮，搭配自然。
除非正在聽具體人士表達需要，否則範圍過窄。

words.note: 較正式，常用於 warning、advice、instruction 等，表示不只是聽到，而是認真看待並採取相應行動。
words.example: Residents were urged to heed the evacuation warning.

exercises.original: Residents were told to pay attention to the evacuation warning.
exercises.zh: 居民被告知要認真聽從疏散警告。

options.explanation: warning 不只是要看見，而是要認真對待並按警告行動。
可表示遵守某些規則，但不如 heed warning 固定自然。

exercises.original: Drivers should pay attention to the safety advice issued during severe weather.
exercises.zh: 惡劣天氣期間，駕駛者應認真聽從安全忠告。

options.explanation: heed advice 表示認真聽取並依照建議行事。
表示快速看一眼，程度不足。

exercises.original: The company failed to pay attention to repeated warnings about the equipment.
exercises.zh: 公司沒有重視有關設備的多次警告。

options.explanation: repeated warnings 顯示問題在於沒有認真理會並採取行動。
可能已經看見警告，但仍沒有重視。
不如 heed 精確表達「聽從警告」。
failed to 後需要原形。 End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 看着不等於專心留意 look at 只表示把視線移向某物；不一定代表真正理解或重視。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can look at a notice without paying attention to what it says.

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意到不等於持續留意 notice 常表示突然察覺某事存在；pay attention to 更常表示有意識地持續留意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She noticed the error and then paid closer attention to the rest of the report.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀看不等於所有「注意」 watch 通常涉及視覺上持續觀看；不能自然代替對 advice、instructions、details 等抽象內容的注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can watch a screen, but you pay attention to the instructions on it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 聽不等於完整注意 listen to 強調用耳朵聽；pay attention to 可以涉及視覺、思考、警告、風險和細節等更廣泛內容。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Students should listen to the teacher and pay attention to the examples on the board.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀察不等於所有專注 observe 常表示仔細觀看或記錄某現象；不一定表示把主要注意力集中在工作或忠告上。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Researchers observe behaviour, while students focus on a task.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忽略和 pay attention to 意思相反 ignore 表示故意或實際上不理會某事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Do not ignore the warning; pay attention to it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞和形容詞不同 attention 是名詞；attentive 是形容詞，表示「留心的」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Please pay attention. The students were very attentive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞和名詞不同 attend 可以表示出席，亦可在 attend to 中表示處理；attention 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She will attend the meeting. She will attend to the complaint afterwards.
